profile.name: Seth Taylor
profile.bio: I am a PIMS Postdoctoral Fellow in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Saskatchewan. I earned my Ph.D. from McGill University in the Department of Mathematics and Statistics under the supervision of Jean-Christophe Nave.
profile.interests: My core expertise is in computational mathematics, numerical analysis, and geometric mechanics. My research interests span information theory, optimal transport, atmospheric dynamics, machine learning, and computational ecology.
